recipes.name: Homemade Crunchy Croutons
instructions: Slice or tear the bread into 1 cm cubes.
Add the bread, oil, garlic, herbs and spices to a large bowl and toss to combine.
For the pan-fried version: heat a bit more oil in a large pan over high heat. Add the coated bread and stir often, cooking for 5 minutes or until golden and crispy.
For the oven-baked version: preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C)*. Spread the coated bread onto a lined baking tray and bake for 7 to 10 minutes, mixing once halfway. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection).
Storage Keep in an airtight container on the counter for up to 2 days.
